context:
PR 966 writes this page's link into Banchi's layout extras file. That same file tells the shared tools Banchi uses the shared record layout. Then the merge tool rebuilds a records page, which needs a one-line summary in every decision and debt record. About 300 decisions and 90 debts have none, so every merge would be refused.
I dropped PR 966 from the batch so the other four can merge. Nothing else needs the link file: lanes bring their questions to me, and I know the page.

options.gain: No work, and merges keep working.
options.how: Close it for now. The page keeps working; the link lives in my handoff.
options.label: Park PR 966
options.lose: Shared tools that look up a repo's waiting page find none for Banchi.

options.gain: Banchi's records show on the shared records page, and the link is found by every tool.
options.how: A records lane adds a summary line to every decision and debt record, then PR 966 merges.
options.label: Move Banchi to the shared record layout
options.lose: A large records-only change touching about 390 files.

ref: PR 966 (waiting-page link in the layout extras file)
title: Park the waiting-page link file, or move Banchi's records to the shared layout?
why: The link file buys little today, and the roll-out is a large change nobody asked for yet.
